question: Did Box's fiscal Q2 2027 (quarter ended July 31, 2026) revenue, non-GAAP operating margin and GAAP EPS come in above or below the company's own guidance from its fiscal Q1 2027 earnings release in May 2026?
grading: Key points: (1) revenue USD 321.1M vs guidance of about USD 319M = ABOVE (+0.7%); (2) non-GAAP operating margin 29.4% vs about 28.5% = ABOVE; (3) GAAP EPS USD 0.09 vs about USD 0.11 = BELOW (FX impact cited); optional: non-GAAP EPS USD 0.40 vs about USD 0.39 = slightly above; GAAP operating margin 10.2% vs about 10.0% = above. Benchmark must be company guidance (May 26, 2026), which Box gives as point estimates ('approximately'). Fail if GAAP EPS is called a beat or the quarter is described as beating on every metric.
answer: Against the Q2 FY27 guidance in the May 26, 2026 release [H18-E1], Box's results for the quarter ended July 31, 2026 [H18-E2][H18-E3] were: revenue USD 321.1 million vs about USD 319 million = above (+0.7%); non-GAAP operating margin 29.4% vs about 28.5% = above; GAAP EPS USD 0.09 vs about USD 0.11 = BELOW (the company cited a USD 0.04 FX headwind). Also: non-GAAP EPS USD 0.40 vs about USD 0.39 (above) and GAAP operating margin 10.2% vs about 10.0% (above).

**Question:** Did Box's fiscal Q2 2027 (quarter ended July 31, 2026) revenue, non-GAAP operating margin and GAAP EPS come in above or below the company's own guidance from its fiscal Q1 2027 earnings release in May 2026?
*As of 2026-10-03*

**Interpreted as:** 'Box's' read as Box, Inc. (ticker BOX), fiscal year ending January 31; fiscal Q2 2027 = 2026-05-01 to 2026-07-31. Guidance compared against is the outlook published in the Q1 FY2027 earnings release (8-K filed 2026-05-26), the preceding period's release. Revenue = total revenue as reported; non-GAAP operating margin = company-defined non-GAAP operating margin; GAAP EPS = GAAP diluted EPS. Box guides non-GAAP EPS rather than GAAP EPS, so the GAAP EPS comparison is made against any GAAP EPS guidance if one exists; otherwise the answer notes no GAAP EPS guidance was given and reports the actual against the non-GAAP EPS guidance for context.

| | Q2 FY27 guidance (issued with Q1 FY27 results, 2026-05-26) | Q2 FY27 actual (quarter ended 2026-07-31) | Above/Below guidance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue (USD millions) | $319 million [1] | $321.1 million [2] | Above [2][1] |
| Non-GAAP operating margin (%) | 28.5% [1] | 29.4% [2] | Above [2][1] |
| GAAP diluted EPS (USD) | $0.11 [1] | $0.09 [2][3] | Below [2][1] |
| Non-GAAP diluted EPS (USD) — context | $0.39 [1] | $0.40 [2] | Above [2][1] |

- Box's Q2 FY2027 guidance was published in its Q1 FY2027 earnings release (8-K EX-99.1 filed 2026-05-26), which guided Q2 FY27 revenue of approximately $319 million, GAAP operating margin of approximately 10.0% and non-GAAP operating margin of approximately 28.5%, GAAP net income per share of approximately $0.11 and non-GAAP diluted net income per share of approximately $0.39. [1]
- Box reported Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended July 31, 2026) revenue of $321.1 million, above its Q2 FY27 guidance of approximately $319 million. [2][1]
- Box reported Q2 FY2027 non-GAAP operating margin of 29.4%, above its Q2 FY27 guidance of approximately 28.5%. [2][1]
- Box reported Q2 FY2027 GAAP diluted EPS of $0.09, below the GAAP net income per share guidance of approximately $0.11 that it had issued for Q2 FY27; the company attributed $0.04 of the shortfall to unfavorable foreign currency exchange rates. [2][1]
- For context, Box's Q2 FY2027 non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.40 was above its Q2 FY27 non-GAAP diluted net income per share guidance of approximately $0.39. [2][1]
- Box's CFO stated that Q2 FY2027 revenue, billings and operating margin all exceeded the company's expectations. [2]
